'''Erdi the Relentless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] living during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erdi the Relentless was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for Dark vs. Light system. Whenever the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Erdi the Relentless has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] alongside other Dark Side World Bosses. Though killing him is required for an in-game achievement, it is impossible to determine when and where his death took place.
